summary: F1 Sign-in return path fails: login next leads to GET of POST-only book URL (405); AC-2.3 unmet
F2 CSRF token undefined before a session exists so login and signup forms cannot be protected
F3 Single-admin rule not enforced and admin bootstrap can leave a stray or promoted admin
F4 Login throttle unsafe behind platform proxy: shared IP key lockout or spoofable header; counters lost on restart
F5 T2/T3/T4 not independent: shared booking rules and write-transaction helper undefined; cross-task tests unowned
F6 No early deploying skeleton; hosting choice left until after five tasks and T6 overloaded
F7 ADR-0003 hand-rolled scrypt auth accepted conditionally: pin params cap length hash outside tx dummy hash
F8 Refusal rule precedence unspecified and now not read once inside the lock after locking
F9 Time edge cases: 30 days vs DST, nonexistent or repeated London local times, edit into the past
F10 Email details: outbox row ownership, retry block, unlimited mail via rebooking, header injection, unverified addresses
F11 Session and cookie details: dual Secure switch, no session purge, next validation gaps, __Host- prefix
F12 No input length limits or email shape check or request body size limit
F13 Backups not runnable: no scheduler or off-box copy or credential; account deletion semantics undefined
F14 Observability below default: nobody named for uptime alert and no unhandled-exception log test
F15 Single admin without MFA or reset is an unstated risk acceptance; want longer admin password and last sign-in note
F16 T1 and T2 exceed the 400-line PR limit; also need a real-HTTP race test and production SQLite settings in tests
F17 Add HSTS and Referrer-Policy headers; note WAL needs a local disk
F18 My bookings hides admin-cancelled bookings; show as cancelled by the studio
F22 Pages embedding a CSRF token (login signup visitor class page) must send Cache-Control no-store
F23 Trusted-proxy hop count rests on an unverified Render claim; verify after first deploy (T8 smoke check)
F24 Storage for the 20 per hour per-user action cap is not defined (need table in 0001 migration)
F25 Bootstrap flags ADMIN_ALLOW_EMAIL_CHANGE and ADMIN_PROMOTE_EXISTING have no stated effect or flagged-path tests
F26 Parallel task wiring: T2 must register empty routers; four concurrent workers exceed cap of three
F27 Spec out of date versus agreed design (AC-1.1 1.2 3.6 3.7 4.1 6.3 admin password); update before T4 and T5
F28 Admin backup download includes sessions and login failures; needs rate limit or exclusion
F29 Last sign-in failure count reads from purged login_failures table so count covers only one day
